note: Fiji's largest banks are BSP Fiji, ANZ Fiji and Westpac Fiji. ANZ Fiji: its interest rates page gives its Visa Classic, its only personal credit card, 20.50% a year; its disclosure of fees and charges for lending and credit cards (effective 23 September 2026) gives a $50 joining fee, a $50 annual fee, a $20 late payment fee, a $7.50 dishonoured cheque fee, a $5.00 cash advance fee, a 1.5% currency conversion fee and up to 45 interest-free days. The Visa Business card isn't written. BSP Fiji's interest rates (current at 7 September 2026) give its VISA Essential and VISA Gold 20.75% a year, but both of its lending and credit card fee schedules linked from its card pages answered 404 and its banking services brochure (10 August 2026) prices no credit card, so its cards' fees aren't known and they aren't written. Westpac Fiji's card terms weren't reached. Wave 4 (30 October 2026), for a second and third bank: Westpac Fiji, named above among the three largest, was reached: its interest rates (current at 1 August 2026) give its Westpac Classic Visa Credit Card, its only personal credit card, 19.50% a year; its fees booklet (May 2024, still the one its card page links) gives no joining fee, a $50 annual fee from the second year on (written with the first year waived), a $20 late payment fee, a $10 cash advance fee and a foreign currency conversion fee of 2.5% (effective 4 June 2024, replacing 2%); its card page asks a minimum of 5% of the outstanding balance each month and gives up to 55 days interest free when the full closing balance is paid by the due date. The Business card isn't written. HFC Bank's home page links no credit card, and BRED Bank Fiji's lending fees brochure (12 January 2026) and interest rate schedule price none, so no third bank is written; BSP's cards remain unwritten for want of their fees. Wave 5 (2026-10-30), minimum payments: ANZ Fiji's credit card conditions of use (effective 18 November 2024, read 2026-10-30): within the limit the minimum is the greater of 5% of the closing balance or 35 dollars, the whole balance below 35; at or over the limit, 5% of the limit (not modelled); written on the Visa Classic as 5% with a 35 floor.
